serviceName: K8 HQ: prove you own this domain. Approve only if you are setting up K8 HQ yourself right now.
description: Adds the one TXT record that proves an organization controls the domain. Changes nothing about where mail is delivered.
variableDescription: %verifytoken%: the proof token K8 HQ issued for this domain (the record's value is k8hq-verify=<token>)
